initial_storage.provenance: Both cells are uninitialized image storage and therefore loader-zero. They have no raw PE bytes to interpret as initialized data.
initial_storage.no_crt_entry: No CRT initializer or atexit callback owns 0109CF14. Application initialization calls the lazy getter at 0073E14B; application shutdown calls 007363B0 at 0073830F.

original_routines.name: BSP_DiagnosticSink_GetOrCreate
original_routines.abi: cdecl, no native inputs, EAX final current 0109CF14 publication, RET
original_routines.behavior: Warm path returns the first publication read. Cold path performs first raw manager lookup, captures manager+10, enters and increments its physical +18 depth, rechecks 0109CF14, allocates four bytes, writes CE752C, publishes, performs a second manager lookup, reloads current 0109CF14 for BD0C30 registration, releases the captured section, and finally reloads 0109CF14.

original_routines.name: BSP_DiagnosticSink_ScalarDeletingDestructor
original_routines.abi: ECX owner, stacked flags, EAX original owner, RET 4
original_routines.behavior: Tests flags bit zero before mutation, clears current 0109CF14 unconditionally, writes base profile CE3818, frees the captured owner only when bit zero was set, and returns the original address. It never unregisters itself.

original_routines.name: BSP_Singleton_Destroy_0109cf14
original_routines.behavior: Fast null check; first manager lookup and captured manager+10 section; enter and depth increment; recheck; second manager lookup; unregister the current 0109CF14 through BCFCA0; reload current publication; call current virtual slot zero with flags1; clear 0109CF14; release the captured section.

original_routines.name: BSP_SystemSingletonGuard_Destroy
original_routines.behavior: Captures guard+04, writes CE37FC, then decrements captured section+18 and calls LeaveCriticalSection.

original_routines.name: raw singleton manager drain
original_routines.behavior: Pops a current registered slot before virtual slot-zero deletion with flags1, then recounts. CE752C therefore naturally reaches 004BBCA0 in the original.

construction_and_profiles.constructor_conclusion: There is no called standalone base or derived constructor for this four-byte owner. The optimized cold getter performs the complete derived construction as the single CE752C store at 004C1524. The derived scalar entry performs the base-profile transition directly; 00412430 is not called on that path.

raw_manager_contract.getter: 00415350 reads and, if needed, allocates/constructs/publishes the raw 14h manager through 01090AA0. It has no publication lock.
raw_manager_contract.register: 00BD0C30 validates end >= begin, ignores null, and appends a nonnull current publication without AddRef, duplicate filtering, or an internal lock.
raw_manager_contract.unregister: 00BCFCA0 linearly finds the current object and writes a null slot without shrinking the vector.
raw_manager_contract.original_shutdown: 007363B0 unregisters before scalar deletion, so a normal later manager drain cannot delete the diagnostic twice.
raw_manager_contract.source_fallback: A reconstructed raw manager drain may delete CE752C directly after popping it; its finite deletion map must receive the same 0109CF14 cell so 004BBCA0 can clear it.

failure_and_mutation_schedule.getter_warm: A nonnull first 0109CF14 read returns immediately and touches no manager or section.
failure_and_mutation_schedule.getter_guard_arm: State zero is armed only after EnterCriticalSection returns and the captured section+18 increment completes.
failure_and_mutation_schedule.getter_recheck: A publication installed during entry skips allocation and registration, but the same captured section is released and the final publication is reloaded.
failure_and_mutation_schedule.getter_allocation: There is no owned-allocation EH state because construction is only a profile store. A registration or second-manager failure retains the published allocation and invokes only the captured guard cleanup.
failure_and_mutation_schedule.getter_registration: The second manager result and the then-current 0109CF14 value are used. A mutation can therefore register a publication different from the object initially allocated.
failure_and_mutation_schedule.getter_leave: State zero remains armed through normal depth decrement and LeaveCriticalSection. A C++ exception after the real Leave operation reaches the same guard cleanup schedule; exact native asynchronous SEH and second-exception behavior are outside source parity.
failure_and_mutation_schedule.shutdown: 007363B0 uses the same capture/enter/recheck pattern. Unregister failure leaves the publication and invokes guard cleanup. Successful scalar deletion is nonthrowing, clears the cell before the wrapper's final redundant clear, and frees only through flags1.

original_direct_getter_uses.note: The older semantic gui_startup comment says twenty call sites; live guarded xrefs establish twenty-four call instructions in twelve functions. No caller owns a second publication.
